info.title: UbiquityOS AI Gateway API
info.description: The OpenAI-compatible inference API for AI.UBQ.FI. Authenticate with an approved UbiquityOS gateway token, query /v1/models before choosing a model, and use the published JSON error envelope and rate-limit fields for autonomous clients.

externalDocs.description: Developer portal, authentication guidance, and examples

tags.name: OpenAI compatibility
tags.description: OpenAI-shaped model discovery and inference endpoints.

tags.name: UbiquityOS extensions
tags.description: Documented gateway capabilities that are separate from the official OpenAI schema.

tags.name: Service discovery
tags.description: Public liveness and machine-readable service documentation.

get.description: Returns public release liveness only. It does not send an inference request, query provider health, or require a bearer token.

200.description: The active release is serving requests.

get.description: Without query parameters, returns the strict OpenAI-compatible model-list shape. Supplying one exact client_version uses the separate Codex-native compatibility contract and returns the richer upstream catalog for that client version; do not treat that versioned response as an official OpenAI schema.

200.description: The OpenAI-compatible list, or the documented Codex-native catalog when client_version is supplied.

post.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions response. Set stream to true for server-sent events. Function tools use the typed FunctionTool schema; select a model from GET /v1/models first.

200.description: A JSON chat-completion object when stream is false, or server-sent events when stream is true.

post.description: Creates an OpenAI-compatible Responses API result. The input field is optional when the caller supplies instructions or a supported continuation context. Set stream to true for OpenAI Responses server-sent events.

200.description: A JSON Responses object when stream is false, or OpenAI Responses server-sent events when stream is true.

get.description: Returns gateway metadata such as reasoning support and context-window limits. This extension is intentionally separate from the strict OpenAI /v1/models response.

200.description: Gateway-specific capabilities for the current model catalog.

bearerAuth.description: An approved UbiquityOS gateway token. Obtain it through an authorized operator workflow; never paste it into prompts, source control, or a public URL.

ClientVersion.name: client_version
ClientVersion.description: An exact Codex CLI version. Supplying this field switches GET /v1/models to the separately documented Codex-native catalog contract.

RetryAfter.description: Seconds to wait before retrying a 429 response.

RateLimit.description: RFC 9449 structured rate-limit field, emitted only when the gateway has an authoritative API-key request window. Example: limit=100, remaining=0, reset=60.

RateLimitPolicy.description: RFC 9449 rate-limit policy, emitted for bounded gateway API keys. Example: 100;w=3600.

RateLimitLimit.description: Compatibility field for the request limit in the active API-key window.

RateLimitRemaining.description: Compatibility field for requests remaining in the active API-key window.

RateLimitReset.description: Compatibility field for seconds until the active API-key window resets.

id.description: Model identifier accepted by inference routes.

ModelList.description: The strict OpenAI-compatible unversioned model-list response.

CodexNativeModelCatalog.description: The rich catalog returned only by GET /v1/models?client_version=X.Y.Z. Its records follow the supporting Codex client contract rather than the official OpenAI model-list schema.

ChatMessage.description: A Chat Completions message. Content may be text or a supported multimodal content array.

JsonSchema.description: A JSON Schema object used to validate function arguments. Use explicit properties, required fields, and additionalProperties: false whenever possible.

FunctionDefinition.description: A callable function definition for an LLM tool.

description.description: Clear instruction for when the model should call the function.

strict.description: Request strict argument generation when supported by the selected model.

FunctionTool.description: An OpenAI function tool. Tool execution remains the client's responsibility; never use a tool definition to disclose credentials.

ToolChoice.description: Controls whether and how the model may select a function tool.

ChatCompletionRequest.description: An OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions request. Additional documented OpenAI fields may be accepted by the gateway, but clients should start with this portable shape.

model.description: A model returned by GET /v1/models. Omit only when an operator-configured default is acceptable.

reasoning_effort.description: A tier advertised by the selected model catalog, or none.

ResponseInput.description: A Responses API input string or structured input-item array.

ResponseRequest.description: An OpenAI-compatible Responses API request. Input is optional so an approved continuation or instructions-only request can use the configured default behavior.

ChatCompletionResponse.description: A Chat Completions response. The concrete payload depends on the selected model and whether tools were called.

ResponseObject.description: A Responses API response. Output items can contain text, tool calls, and tool-call outputs according to the selected request.

ModelCapabilitiesResponse.description: Gateway-specific model capability metadata. This is not an official OpenAI response shape.

ErrorEnvelope.description: The OpenAI-style JSON error envelope returned for API failures. Read error.message for an actionable resolution hint and error.code for programmatic handling.

InvalidRequest.description: The request body, query, or model selection is invalid. Read error.message and error.param before changing the request.

Unauthorized.description: A valid bearer token is required. Obtain access through the authorized operator workflow; do not submit a token in a prompt.

RateLimited.description: The authoritative gateway API-key request window is exhausted. Honor Retry-After and RateLimit fields before retrying.

UpstreamFailure.description: The gateway could not obtain a required upstream catalog response. Retry according to the returned JSON error.

ServiceUnavailable.description: The gateway or a required upstream dependency is temporarily unavailable. Read the JSON error and retry only when appropriate.
